label: Pattern CAD
summary: VENIA's own pattern drafting CAD, as its own module: drafting, grading, markers, pattern cards and factory files (DXF-AAMA/ASTM, plot files), with a DXF round trip to CLO. Built in its own private repository and loaded here, in a frame, only for signed-in members allowed it; it also runs on its own.

source.served: netlify/functions/pattern-cad.js reads the CAD's own dist/index.html from GitHub at the pinned commit (checked against its hash) and hands its styles and script only to a signed-in person allowed Pattern CAD, with it switched on. Needs PATTERN_CAD_GITHUB_TOKEN (read-only Contents on that one repository) on the Netlify site.
source.rule: No CAD code is ever committed to this public repository. Changes to the CAD are made in its own repository; VENIA OS moves to them by re-pinning.

nav.label: Pattern CAD
nav.group: top level (desktop bar, phone menu Spaces)

entitlement.note: Its own switch so it can be sold on its own. A venia_entitlements row with module 'pattern-cad' and status 'off' or 'paused' hides it; no row means on (VENIA has no row). It does not need Product.

localStorage: venia-pattern-cad:* (only if IndexedDB is unavailable on the device)
owns.note: Styles, versions, blocks, fabrics and rule sets are kept on the device, as the CAD does on its own. No cloud tables yet.

access.grant: a founder, a venia_members row with module 'pattern-cad', or (for now) anyone who can read Product
access.enforced: by netlify/functions/pattern-cad.js, which serves the CAD's code only after these checks

otherModules: product.line (core.catalog) via the shell, only while Product is on: list_styles and get_style for 'Link to a VENIA OS style' (read only, no costs or prices). Without Product the CAD links by style code instead.

provides.pending: product.patterns: the hand-off of a pattern (pieces, grading, measurements, export files) to tech packs and other modules. Waits on the shared hand-off contract. The CAD already builds a 'venia-pattern-package' (manifest.json plus project file, DXF and pattern card) that it can offer through it.

hostContract.transport: window.postMessage, same origin only, source 'venia-module' from the frame and 'venia-os' from the shell

toHost.pattern-cad:gate: {text} when it cannot load (not signed in, no access, not connected)

licence.cad: VENIA's own code (keeterly/venia-pattern-cad), built clean-room; no third-party CAD code
